title: Finite presentation of a module is local for an etale neighbourhood
statement: Let $g:(X',x')\to(X,x)$ be an etale morphism of schemes [def-weil-etale-morphism] inducing an isomorphism on the residue fields at the marked points [def-weil-residue-field]. For a quasi-coherent module $\mathcal M$ on $X$ [pqf-def-coherent], $\mathcal M$ is of finite presentation on some open neighbourhood of $x$ [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation] if and only if $g^*\mathcal M$ is of finite presentation on some open neighbourhood of $x'$.

source.place: Tag 057T, proof of (1)⇔(4), using Modules Tag 01PC and Descent Tags 02L2 and 03C4 together with Morphisms Tag 03WT.

proof.text: Use the ordinary scheme module pullback, identified with tensorPullback by uniqueness of left adjoints to pushforward (nonempty_tensorPullbackAdjunction and pullbackPushforwardAdjunction). Private proved helpers transport finite presentation through the opens/over-site equivalence, identifying (M.over U).IsFinitePresentation with (M.restrict U.ι).IsFinitePresentation. These helpers apply the existing finite-presentation pushforward theorem for continuous cocontinuous left adjoints to the site equivalence in both directions, then use overFunctorEquiv and the equivalence unit.

For any V contained in the inverse image of U, compose restrictFunctorIsoPullback, pullbackCompOfEq for resLE_comp_ι, the ordinary pullback composition isomorphism, and the tensor/ordinary comparison to identify the pullback of M restricted to U along g.resLE U V with tensorPullback g M restricted to V. In the forward direction take V=g inverse image U. The proved ordinary-pullback preservation instance in WeilConjectures.AlgebraicGeometry.Modules.FiniteDescent gives finite presentation, and g x′=x gives membership.

In the reverse direction set U=g(V), an open by the étale open-map theorem, and q=g.resLE U V. It is étale by the resLE instance (open-immersion composition and étale restriction/cancellation), and surjective directly from the definition of U. Its singleton family belongs to fppfPrecoverage by Hom.singleton_mem_fppfPrecoverage and therefore generates an fpqc covering sieve by fppfTopology_le_fpqcTopology. This existing Mathlib inclusion packages the quasi-compact refinement condition; no separate affine-refinement construction is needed.

Apply isFinitePresentation_of_toDescentData_iso to the singleton family q, the descent datum of M restricted to U, and its identity isomorphism. The only component is the ordinary pullback along q, which has finite presentation by the comparison of Step 2 and the given restriction over V. Transport the conclusion back through the opens/over-site equivalence. The image U contains x because x′ belongs to V and g x′=x. The residue-field hypothesis is retained but unused.
